svg.title: Share of days with net CO2 uptake (daily NEE < 0) per site-year, over the whole year and over the 90-day window with the largest GPP sum, with the SMEAR II Hyytiälä forest as a reference.
svg.desc: Grouped bar chart of 22 site-years: the 16 site-years of Figure 3 and 6 site-years of the SMEAR II Hyytiälä forest (reference, last group). Per site-year, the left bar (full site colour) is the share of days with daily NEE < 0 over the whole year, the right bar (lighter, hatched) the share inside the 90 consecutive local days with the largest GPP sum of the year; y axis days with net uptake (%), 0 to 100, dotted line at 50 %. Mean ± SD (range) of the whole year: forest 44 % ± 4 % (36 % to 50 %, n = 6), grassland 31 % ± 4 % (25 % to 37 %, n = 11), annual crops 36 % ± 29 % (18 % to 87 %, n = 5); of the peak window: forest 91 % ± 6 % (82 % to 98 %, n = 6), grassland 79 % ± 7 % (68 % to 91 %, n = 11), annual crops 76 % ± 7 % (69 % to 83 %, n = 5), Finnish sites of the database 78 % ± 7 % (68 % to 91 %, n = 15). Maktau 2019 maize: 87 % of the year, window 2019-10-03 to 2019-12-31 81 % (mean measured fraction 0.75). Hyytiälä: Hyytiälä 2020: 36 % of the year, window 2020-06-01 to 2020-08-29 82 % (mean measured fraction 0.96); Hyytiälä 2021: 45 % of the year, window 2021-05-27 to 2021-08-24 89 % (mean measured fraction 0.96); Hyytiälä 2022: 43 % of the year, window 2022-06-04 to 2022-09-01 87 % (mean measured fraction 0.97); Hyytiälä 2023: 42 % of the year, window 2023-05-23 to 2023-08-20 96 % (mean measured fraction 0.97); Hyytiälä 2024: 44 % of the year, window 2024-05-23 to 2024-08-20 97 % (mean measured fraction 0.96); Hyytiälä 2025: 50 % of the year, window 2025-06-01 to 2025-08-29 98 % (mean measured fraction 0.87). Other site-years: Anttila 2022: 36 % of the year, window 2022-05-24 to 2022-08-21 79 % (mean measured fraction 0.64); Anttila 2023: 36 % of the year, window 2023-05-10 to 2023-08-07 86 % (mean measured fraction 0.70); Särkisuo 2022: 29 % of the year, window 2022-06-10 to 2022-09-07 74 % (mean measured fraction 0.56); Särkisuo 2023: 31 % of the year, window 2023-07-10 to 2023-10-07 68 % (mean measured fraction 0.54); Haltiala 2022 oats: 24 % of the year, window 2022-05-19 to 2022-08-16 69 % (mean measured fraction 0.69); Haltiala 2023 grass (failed): 25 % of the year, window 2023-05-09 to 2023-08-06 86 % (mean measured fraction 0.68); Haltiala 2024 sunflower: 24 % of the year, window 2024-06-27 to 2024-09-24 83 % (mean measured fraction 0.65); Haltiala 2025 oats: 18 % of the year, window 2025-05-28 to 2025-08-25 69 % (mean measured fraction 0.73); Qvidja 2020: 37 % of the year, window 2020-05-07 to 2020-08-04 83 % (mean measured fraction 0.27); Qvidja 2022: 29 % of the year, window 2022-05-18 to 2022-08-15 77 % (mean measured fraction 0.40); Qvidja 2023: 27 % of the year, window 2023-05-18 to 2023-08-15 71 % (mean measured fraction 0.36); Qvidja 2024: 32 % of the year, window 2024-06-01 to 2024-08-29 73 % (mean measured fraction 0.43); Qvidja 2025: 28 % of the year, window 2025-05-07 to 2025-08-04 83 % (mean measured fraction 0.29); Viikki 2024: 36 % of the year, window 2024-06-15 to 2024-09-12 91 % (mean measured fraction 0.28); Viikki 2025 faba bean: 27 % of the year, window 2025-06-14 to 2025-09-11 80 % (mean measured fraction 0.15).
